256.skip_reason: RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (1024) must match the size of tensor b (512) at non-singleton dimension 3 -- the registered model's own hard-constraint mask is baked to a fixed 128x128 -> 512x512 shape (docs/REGISTRY.md); frame.tiling itself accepts any tile_size, but the model call inside it does not.

C_scaling.note: 1024x1024 (the API's own MAX_INPUT_PIXELS cap) was not additionally tested here -- the trend from 128..768 already establishes the per-tile cost; extrapolating further is arithmetic, not a new measurement (see docs/REGISTRY.md Sec 3 for the existing Mamba 1024x1024 extrapolation, which uses the same method).
